propositions: init.py contains two independent subsystems with different owners and no inter-subsystem calls: host-repo tracker provisioning (init command entry points) and tickets-branch convergence units (dispatched only by ensures._registry())
init.py at 786 LOC exceeds the practical headroom to the 800-LOC hard cap; refactoring must reduce it to ≤650 LOC while keeping both subsystems functional

the ensure units and their content templates (_GITIGNORE, _GITATTRIBUTES) must move together to a new module _init_ensures.py because they form a cohesive concern independent of the init command logic

_untrack_runtime_markers_unit and _UNTRACK_BATCH must remain in init.py because tests monkeypatch _UNTRACK_BATCH as an init module attribute; moving the unit away would silently break that test coverage without causing test failure
re-exporting moved symbols from init.py preserves the ensures._registry() dispatch mechanism and existing test imports without requiring changes to callers
